title: Benchmark Harness Design
designPrinciple: The harness provides consistent tooling for all three runs: fixture creation, artifact inventory, requirements coverage checking, structure checking, API contract checking, test running, and independent evaluation report generation. Harness is design-only in EVAL-4; implementation deferred to EVAL-5 execution.

components.name: Run Fixture Creator
components.description: Creates a fresh, empty workspace directory for a benchmark run. Copies the benchmark spec and run-specific configuration into the workspace.
outputs: Clean workspace directory with benchmark spec

components.name: Run Artifact Inventory
components.description: Scans a completed run output directory and produces a machine-readable inventory of all files, their types, and sizes.
outputs: JSON inventory with file list, counts, extensions
components.antiGaming: File count is recorded but NOT used as quality score input

components.name: Requirements Coverage Checker
components.description: Checks the run output against the 11 functional requirements. Produces a coverage matrix.
components.note: This is a structural pre-check only. Final scoring is done by the independent evaluator.

components.name: Structure Checker
components.description: Checks that expected directories and file patterns exist (e.g., backend/src, frontend/src, database/migrations, tests/).

components.name: API Contract Checker
components.description: Sends curl requests to each expected endpoint and records response status codes. Does not score — just produces a contract report for the evaluator.

components.name: Test Runner Wrapper
components.description: Runs the project test suite and captures exit code + output.

components.name: Independent Evaluation Report Generator
components.description: Takes the evaluator's per-dimension scores and evidence paths, and produces the structured evaluation JSON.

scripts.name: full-evaluation.ps1
scripts.description: Orchestrates the full evaluation pipeline: inventory → structure → requirements → API → tests → rubric scoring → report

implementationDeferredTo: FACTORY-EVAL-5 (Vanilla baseline run) and subsequent phases
